watchdog_basis: Operational timeout for this finite diagnostic, not a user GPU-time budget
candidate_selection: all four predefined checkpoints, no best-step selection
objective: official native latent MSE; no delivery-loss optimization
content_criteria: foreground gray car remains the main subject
wet street and background tall building remain recognizable
no substitution by the reference teapot scene
content_adjudication: not performed; content metrics are not labels
failure_rule: Stop after any model, hash, replay, equivalence, numerical, device or timeout failure; no automatic retry
inference_scope: One development pair; no hypothesis test or population claim
primary_measurements: paired internal/float/PNG loss at identical z
paired latent displacement before and after PIL quantization
internal replay and initial gradient invariance
numeric_gate: torch.allclose atol=1e-5 rtol=1e-5; recorder replay/initial gradient require bitwise equality
positive_h1_rule: descriptive only: internal improvement exceeds delivery improvement; inspect magnitude and mechanisms, no universal threshold
stop_interpretation: Failure of equivalence prevents delivery-gap attribution; no target-side conclusion
implementation_adaptations: extract four exact upstream definitions; do not import target validation modules
freeze unused text_encoder/VAE parameter gradients; only z is optimized
local snapshot loading with offline flags
record at fixed post-update checkpoints including initialization
